title: Webmin through 2.670 before 07d1949 does not escape a save_log.cgi log file path. (CVE-2026-137715)
description: Webmin versions up to 2.670 before commit 07d1949 contain a vulnerability where the save_log.cgi script does not properly escape the log file path. This flaw is relevant in environments where the Webalizer module is accessible, such as shared hosting providers, potentially enabling code execution.
